reviews.author: Vin Min
reviews.text: Our family was on a road trip from NYC to myrtle beach when a wheel bearing blew leaving our Tahoe disable in Goldsboro NC. It being a Saturday at 1 pm most mechanic shops were closed for the weekend leaving us very little options. Irayalis stayed open for us waiting for the car to be towed in, they ordered the parts and fixed the vehicle and we were back on the road in 4 hours from the time the car broke down till we pulled away. Remarkable service!!!! They saved our road trip and they were priced correctly. Many thanks!!! Highly Recommend!!!!

reviews.author: Latasha Adams
reviews.text: My mom lives in North Carolina and was having some car issues. She was very worried about having her car repaired by an honest mechanic. And with me being in another state, made it difficult for me to directly help her. But I was able to find this particular shop online and referred my mom there. Her experience was so wonderful! My mom was grateful to have Ms Irayalis patiently wait for her to arrive with the vehicle and admired on how Irayalis fixed her car with care. My mom enjoyed the quality of service provided by the mechanic and their prices are reasonable. My mom loves her new mechanic and couldn't be any more pleased. Thank you Irayalis Auto Service for help my mom with her vehicle and putting my mind at ease!

reviews.author: Denise Johnson
reviews.text: I went in to get a quote for an A/C compressor for my 99 Toyota Tacoma. While communicating with Irayalis, she made me feel comfortable with allowing her to service my vehicle. She was very professional and knowledgeable when answering my questions. She also communicated with ease about what was needed and how long it would take. The service was reasonably priced and once she finished my vehicle she was helpful in pointing out some suggested reairs. My AC runs great. I would highly recommend Irayalis Auto Shop for anyone looking for a mechanic who is who is honest, fair, knowledgeable, and professional.
